description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Grid_Bars', which extends 'Image_Graph_Grid' and is responsible for rendering alternating bar grids on a plot area in a graph rendering utility. It includes methods for outputting the grid and references external classes and functions related to graph grid rendering.
